name: IntelOwl
description_en: IntelOwl: manage your Threat Intelligence at scale
readme_excerpt: Intel Owl Do you want to get threat intelligence data about a malware, an IP address or a domain? Do you want to get this kind of data from multiple sources at the same time using a single API request? You are in the right place! IntelOwl is an Open Source solution for management of Threat Intelligence at scale. It integrates a number of analyzers available online and a lot of cutting-edge malware analysis tools.
